results.title: Commentarius in Evangelium secundum Joannem (Eriugena)
results.note: No English translation of the full Commentary found. Confirmed the one adjacent hit is a DIFFERENT, shorter work by the same author: Eriugena's Homilia in Johannem (Homily on the Prologue, PL cols 283B-296D) has two English translations (Bamford's 'The Voice of the Eagle', 1990; a D.P. Curtin translation) -- neither is the Commentary itself (cols 297A-348B), which multiple sources describe as untranslated/fragmentary in English. Matches the PL122-WITNESSES.md brief's own prior finding.

results.title: Expositiones super Ierarchiam ecclesiasticam S. Dionysii, prologue fragment (Eriugena)
results.note: TITLE COLLISION RISK, not a clean miss: Paul Rorem's 2005 PIMS volume translates major sections of Eriugena's 'Expositiones in Ierarchiam COELESTEM' (Celestial Hierarchy) plus his prologue to the Dionysian corpus. Our text is titled 'Ierarchiam ECCLESIASTICAM' (Ecclesiastical Hierarchy) -- likely a different Dionysian treatise, but a cursory pass can't rule out a cataloguing variant/mislabel between the two. Needs a rigorous look (compare column range/incipit against Barbet's 1975 Brepols edition of the Celestial Hierarchy commentary) before this one claims 'none' at all, let alone 'First'.
